observes: AUDITIA: engine.bm25_build/bm25_insert/bm25_drop accept the name __stop__; build writes cfg/tf/df/doc/len subtrees under ^BM25Idx(__stop__), which Tokenize then treats as stopwords (82 entries instead of the documented 77), so an unrelated index built afterwards no longer indexes 'doc' or 'len'; drop deletes the stopword list (re-created on next tokenize). Stopword node restored exactly.
